_comment: Demo roles. Each chunk carries an audience list copied from config/sources.json; a query only searches chunks whose audience contains its role. The split is illustrative, not an ImmD classification.

roles.student: A non-local student or recent graduate using a university careers-office deployment.
roles.employer_hr: An HR officer at a Hong Kong employer hiring non-local staff.
roles.caseworker: An internal advisor who can see every document.
